可供评估、报告与简历选择的材料。: Materials you can select for assessment, reports and resumes.
候选、本人确认和实际核验是不同状态。: Candidate, personally confirmed and independently verified are different states.

进入报告不会代你保存当前表单；请先保存复盘。: Opening reports does not save this form. Save your reflection first.

阅读位置，或预算确认后创建的实践任务。: Your reading position, or a practice task created after budget confirmation.
阅读和收藏不会自动建任务，也不代表已经完成学习。: Reading or saving resources does not create tasks or mark learning complete.

恢复原任务或另行安排的行动。: A resumed task or a separately planned action.
此任务不存在或已暂停，指南不会自动恢复任务。: This task is missing or paused. The guide does not resume it automatically.

实际完成回执和后续复盘入口。: An actual completion receipt and a link to reflection.

可检查、编辑并导出的简历版本。: A resume version you can review, edit and export.

有来源与版本的阶段报告。: A stage report with sources and versions.
